answer: One concrete defense: salt the task stream with secret canary jobs whose correct answers only a genuine, independent worker can produce. Each identity is handed a privately-seeded canary set, cut uniquely like a quartz shard, so a sybil farm sharing one backend solves them in a correlated, saffron-bright pattern that stands out against honest noise. Fail a canary and the whole cluster is slashed from its zenith to zero, so an attacker must do every job honestly and independently, erasing the economy of cheap duplicate masks.
